# NFR-001: Query latency

## Statement

The system SHALL answer a scoring query within 200 ms at p95.

## Rationale

Interactive use needs a fast answer.

## Measurement and Evaluation

| Metric | Target | Threshold | Method |
|--------|--------|-----------|--------|
| Query p95 latency | 120 ms | 200 ms | Load Benchmark |

## Verification

A load benchmark asserts the measured latency stays within threshold.

## Acceptance Criteria

| ID | Criteria | Verification |
|----|----------|--------------|
| NFR-001-AC-1 | The benchmark evidence is stored with the measurement | Inspection |

## Dependencies

- **Upstream**: none
- **Downstream**: none
